name: T3 App Template
summary: Admin template for the T3 Stack with a shadcn/ui layout: collapsible multi-level sidebar, theme switching and CRUD tables.
description: Management interface starter built with the T3 Stack and shadcn/ui, aimed at responsive admin screens. Includes theme switching, a responsive collapsible sidebar with multi-level menus and a mobile version, TanStack Table CRUD operations, GitHub login with NextAuth, and multi-select and step-form examples.

responsive collapsible sidebar with multi-level menus and a mobile version
